purpose: Freeze H2 term adjudication together with prior-round label alignment so synonymous constructs are not miscounted as saturation novelty.
independence_order: First adjudicate inclusion, construct, role, and T0 or validation boundary from the supplied round worksheet. Only then consult the frozen prior-round reference for label alignment.
alignment_rule: Reuse an existing term_family_label, search_domain_label, and query_family_label only when the theoretical object, explanatory or validation role, and T0 boundary are substantively identical. Data-source, threshold, transformation, time-window, abbreviation, and lexical variants alone do not create a new family. Create a new label only for a genuinely non-redundant construct or retrieval purpose, and explain why it cannot map to the frozen codebook.
decision_protection: The reference cannot be used to copy an inclusion decision, override source evidence, or change a future-outcome boundary. It contains no model dimensions, selected features, or performance outcomes.
novelty_rule: Round novelty is computed only after H2 label alignment against all finalized earlier rounds. A renamed synonym is not a new term family or query family.
provenance_rule: For artifacts governed by this composite protocol, row-level independent_ai_prompt_sha256 and manifest prompt_sha256 must equal the SHA-256 of this JSON file. The manifest must record the reference paths and hashes plus counts of rows mapped to existing labels and rows creating justified new labels.
